summary.headline: Patristic Critique of Astrology
summary.text: A critique of astrology argues that Basil the Great’s Hexaemeron rejects invocations and incantations, while astrology’s methods are foolish and impious. Biblical and patristic authorities, including Paul’s warning to the Galatians and Gregory Nazianzen’s condemnation of Chaldean divination and magian rites, are cited against the discipline.
